headline: Congress named a Sioux Falls, South Dakota post office building after Staff Sergeant Robb Lura Rolfing.
what_it_does: This law renames the U.S. Postal Service facility at 320 South 2nd Avenue in Sioux Falls, South Dakota, as the Staff Sergeant Robb Lura Rolfing Post Office Building. It changes only the official name of the building. It does not change postal services, rules, or costs.
when_it_takes_effect: The law was enacted on November 25, 2024.
